subject: Work with current R release / Mac OSX?

messages.author: b7d0496a9ec6c44c
messages.subject: Work with current R release / Mac OSX?
parts:
Hi all,

I'm curious if anyone has MPlusAutomation working on a Mac with the current release of R. I am getting error messages (with relatively clean installs of everything) and am curious if it's compatible. 

Loading required package: plyr
Loading required package: boot
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'tcltk', details:
  call: dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...)
  error: unable to load shared object '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.1/Resources/library/tcltk/libs/tcltk.so':
  dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.1/Resources/library/tcltk/libs/tcltk.so, 10): Library not loaded: /opt/X11/lib/libX11.6.dylib
  Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.1/Resources/library/tcltk/libs/tcltk.so
  Reason: image not found
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘MplusAutomation’

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Work with current R release / Mac OSX?
parts:
Hi Tom,

Yes, MplusAutomation does work on a Mac with the latest release of R; however, it requires the tcltk package.  See some additional answers and suggestions here:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/24056670/unable-to-load-caret-package-in-r-on-r-3-1-0-on-osx-10-9

For some people, just reinstalling R seems to help.  You can also check whether you have X11 or XQuartz installed, and if not install those.

It may also be a permissions issue:

http://socserv.socsci.mcmaster.ca/jfox/Misc/Rcmdr/installation-notes.html

Or you may need some additional symlinks:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/18550971/tcltk-library-issue-while-install-rcmdr-package-on-macbookpro

Basically the error is saying it cannot find X11 on your system, so that is what needs to get resolved.

Cheers,

Josh
